# betterado_environment_resource_kubernetes (Resource)

Manages a Kubernetes resource within an Azure DevOps Environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_environment_resource_kubernetes" "example" {
  project_id          = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  environment_id      = 1
  service_endpoint_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  name                = "my-k8s-resource"
  namespace           = "default"
  cluster_name        = "my-cluster"
  tags                = ["env:prod", "team:platform"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) The ID of the environment.
- `name` (String) The name of the Kubernetes resource.
- `namespace` (String) The Kubernetes namespace.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `service_endpoint_id` (String) The ID of the service endpoint (Kubernetes service connection).

### Optional

- `cluster_name` (String) The Kubernetes cluster name.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags to assign to the Kubernetes resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
